recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future ContributorRole changes should be made in the external terminology source of truth or the EBM IG/Citation maintenance stream, not by reintroducing inactive core Citation terminology files.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification CDS R5 request to change ContributorRole author display to "Author/Creator", change its definition to "An entity primarily responsible for making the resource, often called author or creator", and add similar detail to the other contributor-role codes used by Citation.citedArtifact.contributorship.entry.role.
initial_application: Commit e7d479cbe3978099d0b9c16201c07a2f3019dd0c applied J#33093 by editing source/citation/codesystem-contributor-role.xml so author used display "Author/Creator" and the requested definition, while also replacing placeholder definitions for publisher, reviewer, endorser, editor, informant, and funder with descriptive definitions.
additional_context: FHIR-32322 was the umbrella Citation value set request that originally included the ContributorRole item, but its comments state the non-CitationArtifactClassifier concepts were handled in other trackers. Later commit caa1fb75adbcca96f92873c7d958e31f547124bb removed Citation terminology code system/value set source files from core as part of moving code system definitions out of the base FHIR specification, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed Citation resource source from the current build. Current source/fhir.ini active sections do not include Citation or contributor-role, current narrative says Citation moved to the EBM IG, and terminology.hl7.org currently exposes contributor-role author with the requested display/definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source file was edited because the requested R5 terminology is already preserved and there is no active current-core ContributorRole/Citation source to change.

related_jiras.note: Umbrella Citation value set issue that first listed the ContributorRole author display/definition change; comments say the non-classifier concepts were handled in other trackers, so it was context only.
